title: Umutsinzi uri hagati y'impande ebyiri
intro: Mu nkuru z’amateka y’ubuyobozi bw’Imana, hari umuntu umwe ugaragara nk’umutegetsi ukomeye n’umugaragu wicisha bugufi wa Allah. Uyu muntu yagiye mu mpera z’isi, yibonera izuba rirasa ku bantu badasanzwe kandi rigwa mu mpeshyi y’umukara w’umukara. Igitangaje kurushaho, uyu mugaragu yahawe inshingano zo kubaka uruzitiro rudasanzwe ku gihugu cy’ibibi bikomeye. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu w’inkuru muri Korowani?
clues: Nahawe ububasha n'ububasha ku isi n'Imbabazi nyinshi
Nagiye ahantu izuba rirasira n'aho rirenga
Nageze ku bantu batashoboraga kumva ijambo na rimwe
Nategetswe kubaka uruzitiro runini nkoresheje icyuma
Nafunze umwanya uri hagati y'imisozi ibiri miremire nkoresheje icyuma gishongeshejwe
Ntabwo nari umumarayika cyangwa umuhanuzi, ahubwo nari umugaragu Imana yagiriye ineza

trial.label: Igikorwa Gikomeye
options: Kubaka uruzitiro runini rw'icyuma rurwanya Yajuj na Majuj
Kurema intebe y'ubwami ya zahabu yo guca imanza
Kubaka ubwato mu gihe cy'umwuzure ukomeye
trial.answer: Kubaka uruzitiro runini rw'icyuma rurwanya Yajuj na Majuj

location.label: Imiterere
options: Igihugu cya Uzair kiri hagati y'imigezi ibiri
Aho izuba riva n'isoko ry'umukara ryuzuye ibyondo
location.answer: Aho izuba riva n'isoko ry'umukara ryuzuye ibyondo

outcome.label: Isezerano ry'Imana
options: Inzitizi izakomeza kugeza ku munsi w'urubanza
Ubwigenge ku rupfu ku bizera bose
outcome.answer: Inzitizi izakomeza kugeza ku munsi w'urubanza

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
